sources: Hamas statement (Sunday, via Palestinian Information Center / Al Mayadeen / Roya News English); strike casualties via Al Shifa Hospital + Islamic University sources via AFP wire (Dawn, Arab News, FMT) and TRT World
fault_line: 'Ceasefire in name only' vs 'strikes target militants': the university-during-classes detail is the flashpoint -- a campus full of students vs an unconfirmed military rationale.

sections.what_happened: Hamas issued a Sunday statement (and a detailed 4-page statement, per Roya) calling on ceasefire mediators and guarantor states to intervene immediately to stop Israeli attacks, lift the siege and deliver aid. It called the Islamic University campus strikes a 'designated war crime' and part of the 'ongoing genocidal war', accused Israel of moving the Yellow Line westward and blocking food supplies, and said Hamas has fully complied: 20 Israeli captives released alive within 72 hours, 24 of 28 bodies of deceased captives recovered with coordinates given for more, and daily coordination with mediators and the ICRC. Hamas's own figure: 271 Palestinians killed since the Sharm El-Sheikh agreement began one month ago. Separately, the strike toll is corroborated by Al Shifa Hospital (3 bodies received, 8 wounded from the university drone strike; dead identified by university sources as administrative staff, wounded incl. students attending classes) and Gaza civil defence (4 more killed elsewhere Sunday: 2 Khan Younis, 1 Deir al-Balah, 1 north). The Israeli military told AFP/TRT it was 'looking into the reports'. Gaza Education Ministry: 95% of academic-institution buildings damaged in the war; 10 students/educators killed in the past six days. NOTE: the strikes themselves were already recorded in totw-20261025-2000-03; this item is the NEW statement + its compliance figures.
sections.what_verified: Statement existence + contents carried by Roya News English (T3) and TRT World (T3, STATE TR); the strike casualties are independently carried by the AFP wire (Dawn/Arab News/FMT carry the same AFP copy) with Al Shifa Hospital as the named source. Carriers with NO declared registry tier (Palestinian Information Center, Al Mayadeen) are reported with attribution only and do NOT count toward corroboration. Hamas's 271-killed figure is a PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM (Hamas's own count for the post-Sharm El-Sheikh period) and is NOT the same baseline as the Gaza Health Ministry's 1,551 killed since the Oct 2025 ceasefire began (recorded in 2000-03) -- different windows, not a contradiction.
sections.what_disputed: Israeli military has not confirmed or denied the university strike ('looking into the reports'); no mediator response to the Hamas statement was found in-window. Israel's standing position (from prior scans) is that strikes target Hamas/PIJ operatives and infrastructure; that framing was not attached to this specific strike in any source found.
sections.why_matters: Hamas to the mediators: the ceasefire is collapsing -- and it names its own compliance receipts (20 freed in 72 hours, 24 of 28 bodies) while counting 271 killed since the deal.
sections.context: Background: NEW in-window -- Hamas Sunday statement calls on Gaza ceasefire mediators to intervene after Islamic University strike; Hamas 4-page statement claims 271 killed since Sharm El-Sheikh deal, 20 captives freed in 72h, 24 of 28 bodies recovered
